items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I, I never did know Bobo.

ctx.x: Bobo, that's the one I used to start out with. Yeah? He was like a blues singer or something? Yeah, like he was doing.
Yeah? Uh huh. What was his name? Bobo. Fanger, finger pick. Bobo, yeah. You don't know the rest of his name?
I, I never did know Bobo.
